steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ event without creating or searching for another event.
Enable the required eRFX project capability for the buyer tenant.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify that the Recreate Order pop-up opened.
Verify the pop-up includes Product Sheet.
Verify the pop-up includes Auction Configurations.
Verify the pop-up includes Delivery Date.
Verify the scheduling control is present.
Change the recreated event's end-time setting to 60 Mins.
Cancel recreation without submitting or creating an event.
Verify the Recreate Order pop-up closed after cancellation.
Return to the Events list to check that the original event remains available.
Verify the prepared closed RFQ still appears in the Events list after cancellation.
Verify the existing RFQ retains its closed status.
